standard.summary: CNS 会重着色扩散噪声的频谱，用来改善高频细节与噪声纹理。当前在 Lulynx 中是 default-off 的后端契约能力。
standard.effect: cns_strength 控制重着色强度。强度过高可能改变画面纹理或带来不稳定细节。
standard.whenToUse: 需要评估高频细节、纹理保持或噪声谱校准时。
standard.avoidWhen: 当前路线没有随机噪声注入 seam，或任务要求严格复现旧采样结果时。

standard_en.summary: CNS recolours the spectrum of the diffusion noise to improve high-frequency detail and noise texture. In Lulynx it is currently an off-by-default backend contract capability.
standard_en.effect: cns_strength sets the recolouring strength. Too high can change the image's texture or produce unstable detail.
standard_en.whenToUse: When evaluating high-frequency detail, texture retention, or noise spectrum calibration.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the current route has no random noise injection seam, or the task demands byte-exact reproduction of earlier sampling results.

advanced.principle: 在采样噪声空间调整频谱分布，保持 default-off，并通过 sampler capability matrix 判断是否能接入。
advanced.intervention: GenerationRequest → sampler capability → stochastic noise seam。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练时间无变化；若 sampler seam 成熟，推理质量可能提升高频细节。
advanced.tradeoffs: 它不是训练方法，也不能作为 LoRA 训练开关暴露。

advanced_en.principle: Adjusts the spectral distribution of sampling noise; stays default-off and gates on a sampler capability matrix to decide whether it can attach.
advanced_en.intervention: GenerationRequest → sampler capability → stochastic noise seam.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No change to training time; if the sampler seam matures, inference may gain high-frequency detail.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: It is not a training method and must not be exposed as a LoRA training switch.
